protocol.selection: 0.5 * mean(normalized integrated errors) + 0.5 * mean(spatial spectral error in dex)
protocol.normalization: fixed validation seasonal-climatology control error; immutable once scored
protocol.missing: freeze available spectral keys from reference/control qualification; require same keys for every checkpoint
protocol.temporal_spectra: unavailable for selection: nine-month window and reinitialized origins
protocol.variance: report fixed-lead variance without short-record seasonal/trend fitting
protocol.domain: Global, common finite observation and model wet support; geostrophy excludes 5S-5N
protocol.ohc: native-layer integral, complete-column common support, calendar-month means
protocol.velocity_support: Both observed velocity components and complete observed ADT derivative stencil; prediction-independent; EKE uses identical per-origin support
